title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 1.33 (quiet) at 07:00 UTC on 5 October 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 10 月 5 日 07:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 1.33（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest reliable hour-start estimated Kp is 1.33 (1P) at 07:00 UTC on 5 October 2026. The 07:00 hour is complete (60 samples through 07:59; hour-start 1.33/1P, hour-end 2.00/2Z). Last-180 maximum is 5.33 (first at 2026-10-05T05:57:00Z; label 5P). Published-window maximum is 5.33 (first at 2026-10-05T04:32:00Z; label 5P). Window start 2026-10-05T02:59:00Z (358 samples). estimated_kp reached 5.33 this window. The 08 UTC on 2026-10-05 hour is still incomplete (57 samples through 08:56).

evidence.limitations: Values are estimated Kp at 1-minute cadence and can be revised. The card uses the latest hour that has a full 60 samples; the following hour may still be incomplete.
evidence.method: NOAA SWPC planetary_k_index_1m.json. Main card is the hour-start estimated_kp of the latest complete hour. last-180 and published-window maxima are the first occurrence of the maximum estimated_kp in each window.
